name: w1-language-neutral-gates-20260718
title: Make advanced-gate material-code classification language-neutral
description: classifyReviewAssuranceFloorPath (review-assurance-floor.ts:518 whitelist, :506-511 prefixes) is TS-centric, so non-JS code and cross-ecosystem build manifests escape material classification, silently disabling repro-first RED and review assurance floors for py/rs/go projects. Introduce a config-resolved material-code policy service threaded via a hash-bound classification snapshot to floor + repro classification + ProofStory triggers; add an 8-step precedence chain with non-excludable cross-ecosystem manifests; produce degradation diagnostics from buildScopeDiffPack. Per language-neutral-gates-execution-plan.md v4 (double cross-host APPROVE-WITH-CHANGES).
